Cricketer Rishabh Pant Seeks Land in Uttarakhand from CM Dhami

Cricketer Rishabh Pant has appealed to Uttarakhand Chief Minister Pushkar Singh Dhami for assistance in acquiring land in the state. Pant expressed his desire to shift his base from Delhi to Uttarakhand. The Chief Minister's office has reportedly responded to Pant's request. Pant has reportedly been searching for land for three years.
